name: Epiphone
source:
"...I can hear...A song..."

[url=/c29973]Hijiri's[/url] Substance partner.
The first Substance that appeared in the Blue World.
He tried to resonate with many SRX candidates, but none of them were successful until he met Hijiri.
Unlike the other Substances he doesn't talk much.
He only seems to have interest in music.
